city.Maldives.greeting: People speak Dhivehi — a friendly hello is “Assalaamu alaikum” (ah-sah-LAH-moo ah-LAY-koom).
city.Maldives.flag: a red border around a green box with a white crescent moon
city.Maldives.clue.0: dreamed of sleeping in a little wooden bungalow built right out over the sea
city.Maldives.clue.1: couldn't wait to see beaches that glow bright blue at night like a sea of stars
city.North Korea.description: This very secretive country sits at the top of the Korean Peninsula in East Asia. It is known for enormous synchronized dance shows, the towering Ryugyong Hotel, and the sacred volcano Mount Paektu.
city.North Korea.landmark: deep blue crater lake atop snow-rimmed Mount Paektu
city.North Korea.greeting: People speak Korean — say hello with “Annyeong haseyo” (ahn-nyong hah-SAY-yo).
city.North Korea.flag: traced a flag: blue and red stripes with a red star inside a white circle
city.North Korea.clue.0: booked a train ticket toward a secretive country at the top of the Korean Peninsula
city.North Korea.clue.1: studied a guidebook page picturing won notes
city.Oman.description: This country on the southeast corner of Arabia is known for its old clifftop forts, desert oases, and frankincense — a sweet-smelling tree resin traded here for thousands of years.
city.Oman.landmark: great round tower of Nizwa Fort above a date-palm oasis and rugged mountains
city.Oman.greeting: Arabic is spoken here — a warm, everyday hello is “marhaba” (MAR-ha-ba).
city.Oman.flag: red, white and green with a curved dagger in the corner
city.Oman.clue.0: asked about flights to a warm desert country in the Middle East
city.Oman.clue.1: kept asking about a sweet-smelling tree sap called frankincense sold in the markets
city.Pakistan.description: This large country in South Asia is home to K2, the world's second-highest mountain, the rosy-pink salt of the Khewra mine, and wild goats with dramatic spiralling horns called markhor.
city.Pakistan.landmark: pyramid-shaped snowy peak of K2 towering over glaciers
city.Pakistan.greeting: Most people speak Urdu — say hello with “Assalam-o-Alaikum” (ah-sah-LAHM oh ah-LAY-koom).
city.Pakistan.flag: dark green with a white stripe, a white crescent moon and a star
city.Pakistan.clue.0: circled a big country in South Asia, right next to India, on a map
city.Pakistan.clue.1: wanted to climb K2, the world's second-tallest and one of its most dangerous peaks
city.Palestine.description: This land in the Middle East holds the ancient town of Bethlehem, the very old city of Jericho, and groves of gnarled olive trees. Its eastern edge dips down to the Dead Sea, the lowest place on land.
city.Palestine.landmark: ancient Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem among olive-terraced hills
city.Palestine.greeting: Most people speak Arabic — say hello with “Marhaba” (mar-HA-ba).
city.Palestine.flag: pinned on a flag badge: black, white and green stripes with a red triangle on the side
city.Palestine.clue.0: kept talking about heading to a small land in the Middle East near the Jordan River
city.Palestine.clue.1: kept talking about Bethlehem, a town famous as the birthplace of Jesus
city.Qatar.description: Qatar is a small, flat, sandy peninsula poking into the Persian Gulf. It is known for gleaming skyscrapers, its love of falconry, and hosting the 2022 World Cup — the first ever in the Arab world.
city.Qatar.landmark: futuristic Doha skyline across the bay with a traditional wooden dhow in the foreground
